basic_info.description: Exciting opportunity to own a duplex on the highly desirable Valencia Corridor, priced like a condo! This is an exceptional find for first-time buyers and savvy investors alike. Nestled on a quiet, tree-lined street, it's just a short walk from the incredible shops and restaurants on Valencia Street and the vibrant Dolores Park.    The duplex features a vacant, newly updated 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom unit with a private patio, perfect for owner occupancy. The upper unit is currently tenant-occupied, offering significant long-term upside.    Enjoy the best of urban living with just a short stroll to the fantastic Dolores Park and the amenities of Valencia Street. This unbeatable location offers strong investment potential. Don't miss out on this rare opportunity!
